title: 第012章 琴音镇止三邪修，善罚涤荡一方恶
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

为首的高个散修咧嘴狞笑，语气猥琐，色眯眯的眼神在蔡文姬身上来回扫视：

“小师妹，怕是迷路走到这儿的吧？那就是跟哥几个有缘分嘛！要不然就别回去了，留下来陪哥哥们好好乐呵乐呵，保你终身难忘！哈哈！”

其余两人纷纷哄笑，言语粗鄙不堪，极尽恶意与轻薄。

王磊勃然大怒，横剑挡在蔡文姬身前，厉声喝道：“放肆！清风宗弟子在此，尔等作恶多端，还不速速束手就擒！”

“束手就擒？”高个散修像是听到了天大的笑话，哈哈大笑道。

“就凭你？一个炼气四层的废物也敢口出狂言！今天老子先废了你，再好好玩玩这个小丫头！你能咋滴？”

话音未落，他便运转体内炼气四层的灵气，一拳朝着王磊狠狠砸来。

另外两名散修也同时起身，一左一右包抄过来，眼底满是凶光。

面对三人的围攻，王磊毫无惧色，挥剑迎了上去。

刀剑碰撞的脆响骤然响起，灵气激荡，尘土飞扬。

王磊虽然修为与为首的散修旗鼓相当，但实战经验丰富，一时之间竟与三人打得有来有回。

可双拳难敌四手，没过几招，他便渐渐落入下风，气息紊乱，身上多了数道深浅不一的伤口。

为首的散修见状，狞笑更甚：“哈哈！我说什么来着，废物就是废物！给我去死吧！”

他猛地加大灵力输出，一拳狠狠砸向王磊的胸口。

王磊避之不及，眼看就要被击中！

千钧一发之际。

蔡文姬心念微动，技能瞬间触发！

【胡笳乐】！

无形无色的音波之力骤然炸开，在空中飞速弹射、连锁触发！

音波飞速穿梭，精准命中晒谷场上的三名恶修。

下一瞬！

三名还在猖狂大笑、攻势凶猛的散修，动作齐齐定格！

笑容僵在脸上，话语卡在喉咙，身体僵硬如铁，彻底动弹不得。

站着的定在原地，挥拳的僵在半空，抬脚的金鸡独立。

三人意识清醒、听觉视觉完好，却彻底失去了身体控制权。

全员眩晕，集体罚站！

前一秒嚣张跋扈、不可一世。

后一秒原地定身、任人宰割。

巨大的反差，滑稽又讽刺。

王磊收剑后退，看着眼前诡异的一幕，惊得目瞪口呆，手里的佩剑差点掉在地上。

他刚才还在担心自己护不住蔡师妹，已经做好了拼死拖延的准备。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The tall casual cultivator headed by the leader grinned ferociously, his tone was lewd, and his squinting eyes glanced back and forth at Cai Wenji:

"Little junior sister, I'm afraid you got lost and got here, right? That means you are destined to be with your brothers! Otherwise, don't go back, stay and have fun with your brothers, I guarantee you will never forget it! Haha!"

The other two people burst into laughter, their words were vulgar, extremely malicious and frivolous.

Wang Lei was furious, he blocked Cai Wenji with his horizontal sword, and shouted sternly: "How outrageous! Qingfeng Sect disciples are here, you have done many evil things, why don't you hurry up and catch us!"

"Captured without mercy?" The tall casual cultivator laughed loudly as if he had heard a big joke.

"Only you? How dare a waste at the fourth level of Qi Refining speak such arrogant words! Today I will destroy you first, and then I will have fun with this little girl! What can you do?"

Before he finished speaking, he circulated the spiritual energy of the fourth level of Qi Refining in his body and punched Wang Lei hard.

The other two casual cultivators also stood up at the same time and surrounded them from left to right, their eyes full of fierce light.

Facing the siege of the three men, Wang Lei showed no fear and faced them with his sword.

The crisp sound of swords colliding suddenly sounded, spiritual energy stirred, and dust flew up.

Although Wang Lei's cultivation level was comparable to that of the casual cultivators he led, he had rich experience in actual combat, and for a while he actually had a back-and-forth fight with the three of them.

But two fists were no match for four hands. Within a few moves, he gradually fell into a disadvantage, his breath was disordered, and there were several wounds of varying depths on his body.

Seeing this, the leader of the casual cultivators laughed even more ferociously: "Haha! What am I talking about? Waste is waste! Go to hell!"

He suddenly increased his spiritual power output and punched Wang Lei hard in the chest.

Wang Lei couldn't avoid it and was about to be hit!

At the critical moment.

Cai Wenji's thoughts moved slightly, and her skills were triggered instantly!

【Hujiale】!

The invisible and colorless sound wave power suddenly exploded, rapidly ejecting in the air and triggering a chain!

The sound waves shuttled rapidly and accurately hit the three evil cultivators on the grain drying field.

The next moment!

The three casual cultivators, who were still laughing wildly and attacking fiercely, all stopped their movements!

The smile was frozen on his face, his words were stuck in his throat, his body was as stiff as iron, and he couldn't move at all.

The one who was standing was frozen in place, the one who was shaking his fist was frozen in mid-air, and the one who was raising his feet was independent.

The three of them were conscious, with intact hearing and vision, but they completely lost control of their bodies.

Everyone was dizzy and were collectively punished to stand!

One second he was arrogant, domineering and arrogant.

The next second, he was frozen in place and allowed to be slaughtered.

Huge contrast, funny and ironic.

Wang Lei put away his sword and retreated. Seeing the strange scene in front of him, he was so shocked that he almost dropped the sword in his hand.

He was still worried that he could not protect Junior Sister Cai just now, and he was already prepared to delay it to the death.
